text: OVERDOSAGE The symptoms of overdosage of glycopyrrolate are peripheral in nature rather than central. 1. To guard against further absorption of the drug. - use gastric lavage. cathartics. and/or enemas. 2. To combat peripheral anticholinergic effects (residual hydriasis, dry mouth, etc.) - utilize a quartenary ammonium anticholinesterase. such as neostigmine methylsulfate. 3. To combat hypotension- use pressor amines(norepinephrine, metaraminol) i.v.; and supportive car. 4. To combat respiratory depression - administer oxygen: utilize a respuarory stimulant such as Dopram(R) i.v., artificial respiration.
